baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked clauses يَعْلَمَ, أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ, الْحَقُّ مِن رَبِّكَ, فَيُؤْمِنُوا, فَتُخْبِتَ قُلُوبُهُمْ, and هَادِ ... إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal supplies a capacity for disclosure; disclosed truth is recognized as fixed and as coming from a forming Lord. That recognition becomes trusting assent, trust settles the heart into receptive low ground, and divine guidance maintains an even direction.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower makes the epistemic event more than possession of information.
Giving frames knowledge as received capacity rather than self-produced mastery.
Fixed correspondence with reality supplies what the knowledgeable recognize.
Formation and completion make the Lord the developmental source of the truth.
Heart-settling assent converts recognition into trusted commitment.
A low, broad, quiet terrain gives the heart's response receptivity and settledness.
The heart is the responsive center in which recognition becomes orientation.
Gentle direction carries the settled response toward truth rather than merely naming it.
The road externalizes belief as a traversable course.
Balance and straightness specify the maintained quality of that course.

changed_reading.before: People with knowledge recognize truth, believe, become humble, and are guided.
changed_reading.after: A received disclosure recognizes reality as the Lord's formative truth; assent then settles the responsive heart into receptive ground from which guidance can sustain an even course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ع ل م, الْحَقُّ, قُلُوبُهُمْ, and the terminal صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ permit a sign-recognition and alignment mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge reads a distinguishing mark; truth fits its source as precisely as a joint fits its place. The heart is not only an organ but a mold capable of being recast, while guidance supplies direction and straightness supplies corrected alignment.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark turns knowing into recognition by a legible trace.
A thing fitting its joint or vessel models truth as exact congruence with its source.
The mold image allows the heart to be recast into a new orientation.
Direction, manner, and intent turn recognition into an oriented way of proceeding.
The road provides the line along which the recast heart moves.
Evenness and rectitude supply the final alignment criterion.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge accepts a true proposition and receives moral direction.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge detects a source-fitting mark of truth, and that fit recasts the heart so its direction becomes aligned rather than merely informed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ, مِن رَبِّكَ, تُخْبِتَ, قُلُوبُهُمْ, and the path construction support a water, basin, and growth constellation without leaving the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch constellation pictures bestowed knowledge as water routed through a channel and gathered in depth. The Lord's non-dominant growth branch supplies nourishment; the heart is a well and اخبات makes it broad low terrain able to receive rather than shed that gift. Guidance is the directed flow and the path is the resulting support for life and movement.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse that routes flow makes bestowal a delivered channel rather than a static transfer.
Gathered abundant water supplies the latent substance received through that channel.
The split mapped root's nourishment and growth branch makes the source formative and life-producing.
Low broad ground gives the heart a receptive catchment shape.
The well image locates gathered depth inside the heart.
Gentle direction supplies the inferred movement of the received flow.
Support and sustenance make the straight course life-maintaining rather than merely geometric.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge causes an inward attitude of humility.
changed_reading.after: Bestowed knowledge can be carried as an irrigating gift: the heart lowers into receptive terrain, gathers depth, and becomes supportable ground for guided life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet gives خ ب ت a second mapped inventory, خُبُوُّ النار, while the focus itself moves from knowing truth through faith to a changed heart and calm guidance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recognition of fixed truth produces trust and turns the heart away from flare or agitation. On the split root, تخبت can carry a secondary image of a fire dying down, after which guidance appears as composure and good bearing.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure supplies the event that changes the heart's state.
Stable reality counters the instability of inner flare.
Security and confidence name the state produced when agitation subsides.
The non-dominant branch contributes the exact image of fire going out.
Turning gives the heart a transition from flare toward settled trust.
Calm bearing is the visible mode of guidance after the inward subsidence.

changed_reading.after: As a secondary split-root resonance, recognition and trust quench the heart's inner flare, turning it into composed readiness for guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence makes recognition non-linear: an alien casting is placed into recitation, removal follows with a replacement, and the signs are made firm. The same disturbance assays hearts, exposing departure from balance and hardened loss of softness; the knowledgeable heart recognizes truth through the contrast disclosed by correction and then settles rather than hardens.

activation_trace.role: Repeated casting supplies the intrusive placement that initiates the correction sequence.
Distance and severance characterize the cast material as alien to the source later recognized.
Removal followed by a substitute supplies a correction rather than simple disappearance.
Firmness and exact execution give the corrected signs durable integrity.
Assaying metal or people turns the disturbance into a discriminator of response.
Departure from health and balance names one failed response to the assay.
Loss of cardiac softness supplies the opposed heart-state against which اخبات becomes legible.
Disclosure is now activated as recognition through the preceding correction and contrast.
Truth is not only fixed; the correction sequence makes it evident.
Receptive low ground supplies the response opposite to the hardened heart.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders casting, divine removal, and then firming of the signs.
The purpose clauses لِيَجْعَلَ in 22:53 and وَلِيَعْلَمَ in 22:54 place failed and receptive responses on parallel outcomes of the same event.
22:53 and 22:54 repeat hearts but change their material state from diseased or hard to receptive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies correction, assay, and contrasted heart states; I infer the arrow that visible correction helps the knowledgeable identify provenance and that response itself becomes diagnostic. A live alternative is that correction only protects the signs while trial and knowledge are separate effects, not an epistemic method.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge passively receives an already unobstructed truth and then believes it.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge recognizes truth through a corrected disruption: alien material is removed, the signs are secured, and the resulting contrast assays whether a heart hardens or becomes receptive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence names the مخبتين and immediately profiles them through heart-fear, patient self-restraint, maintained prayer, and outgoing expenditure. The contrast between sacrificial material that does not reach God and heart-guarding that does makes اخبات in 22:54 an inward orientation with durable ritual and social outputs, not a passing feeling.

activation_trace.role: Putting the self in protection supplies the inward guarded orientation located in hearts.
The heart is explicitly the locus from which reverence of signs proceeds.
The same low, receptive terrain branch names the people whose conduct is then unpacked.
Heart-felt fear gives receptive quietness responsive intensity rather than numbness.
The profile again locates the response in the heart.
Holding the self against panic makes the response durable under affliction.
Careful maintenance turns prayer into sustained practice rather than a momentary act.
The outward passage of wealth gives the heart-state a social consequence.
Reaching distinguishes inward reverence from flesh and blood as the effective offering.
Self-guarding is what reaches God, reinforcing inward orientation over sacrificial material.
The focus verb reactivates that earlier named and enacted profile inside the knowledge-to-guidance sequence.

structural_cues: 22:34 ends by naming the مخبتين and 22:35 opens with a relative-clause profile of them.
The profile joins inward reaction, endurance, prayer, and expenditure in one sequence.
22:37 explicitly contrasts material sacrifice with the heart-derived quality that reaches God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a named group followed by a behavioral profile and an inward-versus-material contrast; I infer that this profile thickens the later verb تخبت into a stable disposition with practices. A live alternative is that 22:35 only describes the group and does not define every occurrence of the root.

changed_reading.before: Their hearts feel humble after accepting the truth.
changed_reading.after: Their hearts enter the already profiled state of the مخبتين: alert fear held by patience and made durable through maintained worship and material generosity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, worship poised on an edge tilts from direction and a trial flips the worshipper back on his face. Later, travel should produce hearts that bind and understand, but cardiac blindness blocks orientation. Against those failures, اخبات is a lowering from a precarious edge into broad stable terrain, and the straight path is the course a reoriented heart can actually traverse.

activation_trace.role: Inclination away from a direction activates the precarious geometry of worship on an edge.
Trial supplies the force that exposes unstable orientation.
Turning something onto its other face supplies the failed heart-motion.
Actual movement through the land makes orientation and path traversal concrete.
Hearts are the organs expected to process what travel discloses.
A restraining intelligence keeps perception from sliding into ignorance.
Blindness of heart names the failure to orient despite available sights.
Broad low ground replaces the earlier edge with a stable receptive position.
The road is the traversable expression of corrected heart-orientation.
Straight balance opposes both tilt and inversion.

structural_cues: 22:11 joins edge-worship, trial, and bodily inversion in one conditional mechanism.
22:46 joins travel, understanding hearts, and heart-blindness while distinguishing physical sight from orientation.
22:54 joins heart settlement directly to guidance toward a straight road.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge, inversion, travel, cardiac understanding, and straight-road language; I infer one spatial mechanics of orientation linking them. A live alternative is that each image independently describes loyalty, reflection, or guidance without forming a shared terrain model.

changed_reading.before: Humility is an inward emotion and guidance is a later reward.
changed_reading.after: اخبات is a spatial reorientation: the heart leaves the trial-sensitive edge, settles onto receptive ground, and thereby becomes able to traverse rather than merely admire the straight course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice gives a literal water-to-earth transformation: delivered water makes dead ground move, rise, grow, and become green. Those branches activate the focus ayah's gathered-water knowledge, growth-bearing Lord, well-heart, and low receptive ground as an ecology in which disclosure does not merely inform the heart but revives its capacity to bear a guided course.

activation_trace.role: Delivered descent supplies the arrival of water to previously inert ground.
Literal water supplies the material agent in the earth's change.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies activation after reception.
Increase and rising show received water changing the ground's state.
Growth from earth supplies the productive outcome of reception.
The repeated delivered descent confirms the same ecological sequence later in the surah.
Watering and pouring make the delivery causally effective on the earth.
Fresh green growth is the visible result of the received descent.
Gathered abundant water lets knowledge occupy the analogous nourishing position.
The focus root's non-dominant nourishment branch links source, growth, and formation.
Low broad terrain gives the heart the receptive earth-shape required by the analogy.
The well image gives the heart depth in which the delivered gift can gather.

structural_cues: 22:5 sequences descent, water, earth-motion, swelling, and growth with rapid conjunctions.
22:63 repeats descent, water, and greening after 22:61-62's alternation and truth formulas.
22:54 itself sequences reception of knowledge, recognition, heart-change, and sustained direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two literal earth-renewal mechanisms and focus branches for water, growth, lowland, and well; I supply the cross-domain arrow from revived earth to the knowledgeable heart. A live alternative is that the earth scenes only prove resurrection and providence and do not model cognition in 22:54.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge changes an opinion and produces humility.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge can function like delivered water: a receptive heart-ground gathers it, comes alive under the Lord's formative truth, and grows the capacity for a sustained guided course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated declaration that God is the truth enlarges الْحَقُّ مِن رَبِّكَ from a true item sent by the Lord into truth congruent with the identity of its source. The later failure to measure God to His true measure makes knowledge an act of calibration: the learned recognize the message-source fit that failed estimators miss.

activation_trace.role: The first identity formula makes fixed reality a divine predicate, not only a message quality.
Repetition after the focus sustains the source-level truth frame against false invocation.
A measure reaching its due limit supplies the calibration that the deniers fail to achieve.
Due and binding right qualifies the measure owed to God.
Exact fit gives the truth recognized in the focus congruence with its source.
Lordship identifies the source against which the message is calibrated.
Knowledge reads the marks by which source-truth congruence is recognized.

structural_cues: 22:6 and 22:62 repeat the same divine-truth identity formula on either side of the focus.
22:54 uniquely phrases truth as coming from your Lord inside that repeated frame.
22:74 couples حق directly to measuring God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated identity formulas, source language, and due measure; I infer that knowledgeable recognition detects congruence between message and source. A live alternative is that the formulas only reinforce propositional certainty and that 22:74 concerns reverence rather than epistemic calibration.

changed_reading.before: The learned verify that a message from God is factually correct.
changed_reading.after: The learned recognize a fitted correspondence between the truth and its Lordly source; belief is calibrated recognition of who the source is, not only assent to an isolated claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, differing communal rites coexist with an instruction not to be pulled into contest; the call to the Lord is made while already upon straight guidance. If argument continues, superior knowledge and final judgment are assigned to God. This makes the focus path directional fidelity under unresolved difference, not necessarily the immediate elimination of every contested reading.

activation_trace.role: Distinct ritual place and practice supply the concrete plurality surrounding the later straight-guidance claim.
Pulling between two sides supplies the contested force the addressee is told not to enter.
Gentle direction remains asserted in the presence of ritual contest.
Straight balance describes a stance maintained amid rather than after the dispute.
Entwined contention supplies the live argument that does not dislodge the guided stance.
Disclosure is attributed supremely to God when argument persists.
Final adjudication is deferred to divine judgment rather than forced by present polemic.
Each side taking a different course makes unresolved divergence explicit.
The focus road can therefore name faithful direction without claiming that all current difference has vanished.

structural_cues: 22:67 places distinct communal rites, prohibited contest, calling, and straight guidance in one ayah.
22:68 answers continued argument with God's greater knowledge rather than a new forced proof.
22:69 assigns judgment over differences to a later divine act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural rites, ongoing dispute, present guidance, divine knowledge, and deferred judgment; I infer that straightness can be maintained without premature erasure of difference. A live alternative is that these verses regulate polemical conduct only and do not authorize multiple semantic readings of 22:54.

changed_reading.before: Being guided to a straight path means every live difference is immediately settled.
changed_reading.after: Straight guidance can be a stable direction through unresolved ritual and argumentative plurality, with coercive resolution withheld and final adjudication left to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The establishment sequence in 22:41 joins upheld prayer, recognized good, restraint of wrong, and the outcome of affairs. Because مستقيم itself activates the root's care-and-maintenance branch, the focus path can be read as an order continually kept standing through disciplined practice rather than a line merely pointed out once.

activation_trace.role: Care, preservation, and oversight turn establishment into continued upkeep.
Recognized good supplies the positive social norm maintained by that upkeep.
Restraint from action supplies the boundary-maintaining side of the order.
The eventual outcome keeps maintenance directed toward an end rather than self-enclosed control.
Direction and manner make guidance an ongoing way of proceeding.
Care and preservation latent in straightness activate the path as maintained order.
Balance and rectitude state the quality that maintenance preserves.

structural_cues: 22:41 makes establishment productive of recurring worship and social norm enforcement.
The ayah closes by assigning the outcome of affairs to God, limiting human maintenance.
22:54 uses an active divine guiding construction rather than presenting the road as self-sufficient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an establishment-and-upkeep sequence and a focus root that includes both maintenance and straightness; I infer that guidance sustains a practiced order. A live alternative is that 22:41 concerns empowered community conduct while مستقيم in 22:54 retains only ordinary directional force.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is a route identified after belief.
changed_reading.after: The straight path is also an order kept upright through worship, recognized good, and restraint, while its outcome and continued guidance remain divine rather than self-securing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary lowland branch of خ ب ت is nearer than its split-root fire image. It remains valid as an activation because the packet explicitly maps the focus root to خُبُوُّ النار and immediately supplies a trial branch of burning plus hardening hearts. Render it only as a secondary metallurgical-affective resonance, never as a replacement gloss for humility or low terrain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُ قُلُوبُهُمْ anchors the fire's subsidence specifically in the focus heart-response.

activation_trace.role: Burning and its blackening supply the trial-fire immediately before the focus.
Hardness and dryness supply one material result of exposure to that fire.
The packet's non-dominant mapping contributes the exact counter-image of fire subsiding.
Turning locates a changed response between hardening and quenching.
Security names the composure left when the heart's trial-fire dies down.

changed_reading.before: The trial separates hard hearts from humble hearts.
changed_reading.after: In a contained secondary resonance, the same assay that bakes one heart hard can end in another heart's fire subsiding into secure composure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends textual-operation branches into the focus road image. It remains anchored through the explicit recitation, casting, copying, firming, signs, knowledge-marks, and tightly made truth branches. Render it as a scribal analogy for recognition and transmission, not as a historical claim about a physical manuscript or a claim that صراط lexically means a written line.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَعْلَمَ ... الْحَقُّ and صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ anchor the analogy in recognition of a corrected, legible course.

activation_trace.role: Recitation read and placed supplies the textual surface on which interruption occurs.
Receiving and transmitting speech supplies the transfer stage vulnerable to intrusive material.
Copying one written image into another activates textual transmission alongside the stronger removal reading.
Exact, secure construction supplies the stabilization of the transmitted signs.
Visible marks make the secured signs legible to recognition.
Knowledge as distinguishing mark allows the learned to read correction and provenance.
Tightly woven speech gives the recognized truth textual coherence.
The road supplies a contained analogy for the legible course preserved through transmission.

changed_reading.before: The learned simply identify a correct message after an error is removed.
changed_reading.after: As a contained scribal model, they read the marks of a corrected and firmly transmitted text, recognizing a coherent course through rather than outside the history of interruption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it scales a heart's humility up to cosmic and geographic stability. It remains anchored in the focus's low terrain, road, and straight balance while the packet repeatedly supplies shaking, falling, and divine holding. Render it as a spatial resonance about dependable orientation under instability, not as a cosmological explanation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُخْبِتَ ... إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ joins low settled terrain to a stable route in the focus itself.

activation_trace.role: World-scale shaking supplies the maximum condition of lost footing.
Noisy uncontrolled falling supplies the spatial fate opposed to guided settlement.
Divine holding supplies the preserving force that prevents collapse.
Falling and then becoming fixed joins the threat of collapse to the possibility of stability.
Broad low ground gives the heart stable footing without requiring elevation.
The road turns preserved footing into forward movement.
Balance and straightness describe maintained orientation under surrounding instability.

changed_reading.before: Guidance identifies the correct route in a stable world.
changed_reading.after: Guidance preserves traversable footing while worlds, bodies, and loyalties can shake or fall; the humble heart is low yet stable because its course is held in balance.

strongest_changes: The 22:52-54 correction, assay, and purpose sequence changes knowledge from passive reception into recognition sharpened by exposed contrast and provenance.
The earlier مخبتين profile changes heart-humility from a momentary feeling into patient, maintained, and materially generous practice.
Edge-worship, heart-inversion, travel, and heart-blindness change the straight path into a recovered capacity for stable orientation.
Rain-growth branches activate a coexisting heart ecology in which bestowed knowledge irrigates receptive ground and produces guided life.
Later ritual difference and deferred judgment preserve a reading of straight guidance that remains stable without prematurely erasing contest or plurality.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's split mappings for ر ب ب and خ ب ت, together with the immediate cast-remove-firm-assay sequence, kept several unusual but anchored mechanisms alive: developmental irrigation, trial-fire quenching, corrected textual transmission, fitted alignment, and stable terrain. These coexist with the strong epistemic-affective and embodied-practice readings rather than replacing them.
remaining_uncertainties: The paired purpose clauses clearly contrast heart outcomes, but whether correction itself causes recognition or merely precedes a separate divine purpose remains open.
The خُبُوُّ النار branch is packet-backed yet form-distant; its quenching model should remain secondary to the lowland reading.
The water, growth, mold, and scribal mechanisms are coherent branch activations, but their force may be analogical rather than lexical.
The later plurality sequence securely constrains dispute conduct; whether it also licenses multiple semantic readings of the focus ayah is less certain.
